question_text: Choose the sentence that avoids a run-on:

options.text: The exam is difficult I need to study more.
The exam is difficult, I need to study more.
The exam is difficult, so I need to study more.
The exam is difficult I need to study.

hint_ladder.title: Ano ang Run-On?
hint_ladder.text: Run-on yan pag dalawang buong pangungusap (independent clauses) ang pinagdugtong nang walang tamang connector. Isipin mong dalawang jeep na biglang...

hint_ladder.title: Kilalanin ang Clauses
hint_ladder.text: Sa bawat option, may dalawang kumpletong ideya: 'The exam is difficult' at 'I need to study more.' Parehong pwedeng tumayo mag-isa kaya kailangan n...

hint_ladder.title: Tamang Paraan ng Pag-connect
hint_ladder.text: Para iwas mali, gumamit ng comma kasama ng FANBOYS (For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So), o kaya semicolon. Comma lang? Hindi sapat—comma splice ang ta...

hint_ladder.title: Suriin Bawat Option
hint_ladder.text: A at D walang comma, run-on talaga. B may comma pero walang connector, comma splice. C lang ang may comma at 'so'—tamang connective na nagpapakita ...

A.text: You might have chosen A because you missed that two complete thoughts need a conjunction, resulting in a fused run-on.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you thought a comma alone could connect sentences, but it's a comma splice error.

C.text: Correct. This uses a comma and the conjunction 'so,' properly linking cause and effect.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you didn't notice the missing punctuation, which makes it a run-on just like A.

next_time_rule: When joining two complete sentences, use comma + FANBOYS (For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So) or a semicolon. Never just a comma.
deconstruct_text:
Alam niyo, sa barangay meeting, sinabi ng kapitan: 'The budget is approved we will build a new health center.' Run-on yan, kasi dalawang buong ideya na walang connector. Parang nilagay sa iisang plato ang adobo at kanin na hindi halo—puwede naman pero mas maganda may...

Ang secret: Pag dalawang independent clause, kailangan ng comma + FANBOYS (like 'so') o semicolon. Yung comma lang, kulang—parang nag-utos ka ng 'Tuloy' pero walang kilos.

Tandaan: 'Comma lang, bitin; may FANBOYS, panalo!' Isipin na ang comma ay pause, pero ang FANBOYS ang tagapag-ugnay. Kaya sa exam, hanapin ang comma+connector, lalo na kung may cause-effect ang mensahe.
